item.title: Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4 map changes: All new POIs explained
item.summary: Fortnite's island undergoes a major overhaul for Chapter 7 Season 4 Override. New gaming-themed points of interest will be introduced to the island. Iconic locations like Sonic's Green Hill Zone are arriving with the update. Several existing points of interest will be removed and replaced by new ones. The map changes promise a visually distinct and gameplay-rich experience for players.
